text:
Maria: Quick postmortem follow-up — I pulled the action items from the doc and want to lock owners / timelines for the streaming reconnect + partial-response problem. Pls reply with confirmations.

Sam: I can take the reconnect backoff + jitter work. Plan: add exponential backoff, cap at 20s, and opt-in server-side cooldown for hot clients. Target: next sprint (Tue EOD).

Ryan: I will own the timeout tuning and telemetry hooks. Will add per-route timeout histogram + alert when 95th > 3s. ETA: Wed morning.

Jin: I'll do the partial-response detection logic in the proxy and a small reassembly buffer. Also add a metric for incomplete-chunk-rate. ETA: Thu.

Priya: I can run a focused soak and validation on Dedicated clusters once the fixes land. Need a list of test prompts and traffic profiles.

Sam: putting the design notes here: 
```
reconnect: {
  strategy: "exp_backoff",
  base_ms: 200,
  max_ms: 20000,
  jitter: "full"
}
client_cooldown_window: 60s
```

Maria: Thanks. I created GH issue RW-4182 to track all of this and linked the postmortem. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4182

Ryan: quick question — do we want server-initiated retries or client-only? server retries risk duplicate events for some customers. Opinion: prefer client-first, server fallback for non-idempotent flows with idempotency keys.

Sam: Agree. We'll make server fallback opt-in via routing policy and require idempotency token.

Jin: For detection, I'll add heuristics: missing EOF in chunked responses + final-kv-cache-miss patterns. If we see those, proxy marks as 'partial' and triggers reconnect.

Priya: For soak, I can test both Hosted and Dedicated. Can someone add a small harness for simulated network flakiness?

Maria: @Sam can you drop a small chaos harness snippet in the GH issue? Even 5-10% packet loss sim on a canary pool would be great.

Sam: Will do. I'll also include a rollback plan and a feature flag: `streaming.reconnect.v2` so we can disable quickly if regressions show up.

deploy-bot: New branch `reconnect-v2` created and CI pipeline started for RW-4182.

Ryan: I'll wire up the alert and add a Grafana dashboard panel with incomplete-chunk-rate and reconnect-attempts by route.

Jin: FYI — I found a flaky code path in the proxy where a 408 gets swallowed instead of surfaced. Small PR incoming.

Maria: Good catch. Can you reference the PR in the issue when ready?

Sam: Confirming owner list in RW-4182: Sam (reconnect impl), Ryan (timeouts & alerts), Jin (partial detect + proxy fix), Priya (soak & validation), Maria (PM/coord).

Priya: I'll schedule a 30m validation window after the canary deploy. Would prefer Tue 16:00 PT.

Maria: Locking Tue 16:00 PT. Owners: please be available for quick rollback.

Ryan: One more ask — let's add a recurring doc to track if incidents of this class repeat monthly. I can create a short template.

Maria: Yes make it `incidents/streaming-regressions/recurring-checklist` and link the template in the issue.

Jin: PR for 408 fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5621 (small change). QA + code review requested.

Sam: I've added the chaos script to RW-4182 and a short runbook for rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for branch `reconnect-v2` in cluster `canary-023` at 2245673910.

Priya: Canary looks healthy after 10m; reconnect attempts down ~40% on sample traffic. Will continue soak.

Maria: Great progress. I'll update the postmortem with owners/timeline and mark this thread as the canonical follow-up. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
